title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the qualities of a truly wise person
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the qualities of a truly wise person.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"यस्य कृत्यं न जानन्ति मन्त्रं वा मन्त्रितं परे।
कृतमेवास्य जानन्ति स वै पण्डित उच्यते॥"
A truly wise person is one whose plans and actions remain hidden from others until they are completed. Such a disciplined, discerning and thoughtful person is rightly regarded as truly wise.
यस्य कृत्यं न जानन्ति मन्त्रं वा मन्त्रितं परे। कृतमेवास्य जानन्ति स वै पण्डित उच्यते॥ pic.twitter.com/rpM8ZG5DKG — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 1, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (aphorism) on X on 1 September 2026, describing the qualities of a truly wise person as one whose plans remain hidden until execution. The PIB release simply reproduces the verse and its translation with no policy content.
enrichment.context: This is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing a piece of traditional Sanskrit wisdom literature, a practice he engages in periodically to promote Indian cultural heritage and share reflective thoughts with the public. Such posts have no administrative, legislative, or policy implications and are of a purely cultural-inspirational nature.
